While grounded, five perpetrators carried 
knives boarded the vessel. The perpetrators 
threatened the crew while escaping. Some 
metal parts and generator wirings were 
stolen.
One crew member promptly reported the 
incident to CGSS Batangas City when the 
perpetrators	 had	 already	 fled	 the	 vicinity.	
Upon receiving the report, CGSS Batangas 
City deployed personnel to render necessary 
assistance.	All	five	perpetrators	were	arrested	
and sent to the station for investigation.
[ReCAAP Focal Point (Philippines)]
